description: This is a FastAPI backend source file implementing API endpoints for user authentication, portfolio management, and student information retrieval. It defines routes, imports models, handles database interactions, and includes helper functions.

methods.name: startup()
methods.description: Initializes database tables on application startup with error handling.

methods.name: health_check()
methods.description: Health check endpoint returning a simple status message.

methods.name: signup(user_create: UserCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Endpoint for new user registration with email uniqueness enforcement.

methods.name: login(form_data: OAuth2PasswordRequestForm = Depends(), db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Endpoint to authenticate a user and issue a JWT token.

methods.name: create_portfolio( portfolio: PortfolioCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user) )
methods.description: Creates a new portfolio for the logged-in user, including associated projects, skills, and achievements.

methods.name: list_portfolios( db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user) )
methods.description: Lists all portfolios belonging to the current user.

methods.name: get_portfolio( portfolio_id: int = Path(..., description="ID of portfolio to fetch"), db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user) )
methods.description: Retrieves a specific portfolio by ID for the current user.

methods.name: update_portfolio( portfolio_id: int, portfolio: PortfolioUpdate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user) )
methods.description: Updates an existing portfolio and its associated lists.

methods.name: delete_portfolio( portfolio_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user) )
list_students(db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Lists all students with their portfolios.

methods.name: get_student(student_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Retrieves information for a specific student by ID.

methods.name: portfolio_to_response(portfolio_obj, db)
methods.description: Converts a portfolio ORM object into a response model.

methods.name: student_info_for(user_obj, db)
methods.description: Generates student info including portfolios for a given user object.
